evals.prompt: I'm building a project that follows a strict in-house engineering doctrine. It has two core services: `web` — an HTTP REST API that accepts POST /pings and is the public entry point — and `worker` — a background service that consumes jobs from a task queue. `web` enqueues jobs that `worker` processes. I need the provider contract for the `web` service. Produce the complete contract file contents and tell me the exact repo path it should live at. Keep it focused.
evals.expected_output: An OpenAPI contract for the web service that includes the doctrine-mandated health endpoints — its own /health and /health/worker for the downstream dependency, both returning the {"version": "x.x.x"} shape — at infra/contracts/web.openapi.yml.
expectations: DELTA DRIVER (doctrine-specific, not inferable): the /health response carries the service version in the mandated shape {"version": "x.x.x"}

DELTA DRIVER (doctrine-specific, not inferable): defines a GET /health/worker endpoint for the downstream worker dependency that ALSO returns the {"version": "x.x.x"} shape — the mandatory downstream health check, and the core non-inferable /health/<dependency> signature
Defines a GET /health endpoint at all (prerequisite; partially inferable from common convention)
CONFIRMATORY (inferable, expect ~zero with/without-skill delta): the contract is an OpenAPI document (web is HTTP-driven), not AsyncAPI
CONFIRMATORY (inferable, expect ~zero with/without-skill delta): states the file path as infra/contracts/web.openapi.yml (or an equivalent <service>.openapi.yml under infra/contracts/)
